name: layerfs
description: LayerFS for Node: the nine families of the one call table (project, branch, commit, file, sandbox, workspace, machine, store, backup), each a call into the native library (#533).

scripts.prepack: node -e "require('node:fs').existsSync('layerfs.node') || (console.error('layerfs.node is missing: run npm --prefix api run build:native before packing'), process.exit(1))"
